text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This weekend, the debut race will finally be upon us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as for Espoir City's
focus issues...
—Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, what's the matter?
Well, I heard a voice, and... I couldn't help coming over."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I see. So Espoir City's training hasn't been going well...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then how about we try
a rather unique way of arriving early?
choice_data_list: Is that a special forward-riding style?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As long as they apply, Umamusume can arrive
2 to 3 days earlier than usual and still have it
treated as an official excused absence.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And at Kokura Racecourse, the stage for this Debut race,
arriving early lets us train on the actual track.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It might be a good idea to head to Fukuoka early
for a change of pace and scenery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's a solid choice.
Kokura Racecourse is also where we held
the training camp for "Project K."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Training in a special environment
might just bring about some kind of
change in Espoir City."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the downside, we won't be able to use
the state-of-the-art facilities at Tracen Academy, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Desperate times call for desperate measures.
choice_data_list: Tazuna-san! Please give me the application forms!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...'Mom will be cheering for you in front of the TV during your debut race this weekend.'"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah! Are you stupid or something?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't it on TV?"
"Why not just watch it on your phone?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh! You're already getting ready for bed! Even though you usually cut it close just taking a bath!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey.
She is a Feng Shui Umamusume who listens to the voice of the earth as she races on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah... I've got a busy day tomorrow, you know.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out early as a "special" privilege.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Five days before the Make Debut.
Kokura Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
……Phew~~~~!
It's been a while, Kokura……!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like, is there seriously no one here?
Are we the only ones who showed up?
choice_data_list: I think there are only a few groups including us.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hoooo boy...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: If there are fewer Umamusume than during "Project K," we've got the whole track to ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, wanna train?
We could go all out over 1,700 meters just like the real deal?
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we get started right away?
Right, shall we get started right away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, it's all or nothing.
There's no guarantee a change of environment will make things better.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: How many times had I tried to fix Espoir City's habit of looking away leading up to this day?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And through countless failures,
how many times have I written those cautionary tales
into the 'textbook'?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's get psyched!
We're taking 1st place, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone how strong I am right from my debut race!
First impressions are super important, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When she wishes to win so badly,
there's no way I can give up first!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Right... —1700, huh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey. What kind of race...
do you predict this is gonna be?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You're a Trainer, aren't you?
If you know the lineup, you should be able to read how the race will play out!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Um... and while I'm at it, I'll judge your skills for myself.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...C-C'mon! Say it!!"
choice_data_list: ...! Of course I do. The estimated pace is—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll gradually pick up the pace while running...
and then, like, I'll keep a 12-second pace..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, guess I'll give it a shot.
...Number 12, then.
choice_data_list: You can count out loud, you know.
Feel free to count out loud, okay?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! N-Not really...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I just gotta run it in exactly 12 seconds, right?
Don't underestimate me!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Here I come! —Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Push the pace—... Move to the front!
And from here—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can tell even from a distance.
She's running to maintain a steady pace!
Exactly as I instructed—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That solution"
was so simple it ended up being a blind spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason she loses focus is
"because she gets distracted by her surroundings."
In that case...
choice_data_list: (If I let her run somewhere deserted!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Aah, Trainer!!
There are other Umamusume here besides us!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Let us keep our focus and do our best as well.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Daryaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... haaah...!
Phew...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Did that scare ya, you guys who just showed up...!
Scared of my running, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her attention might currently be directed toward other Umamusume and Trainers,
but before that, she was plenty focused.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I want to try it again when nobody else is around.
And to make that happen—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh, our training schedule?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
I think we should be done around 18:00 normally. At the very latest, by tonight.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, you're here.
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Did it stop raining? Our night training, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wrote a note into my textbook.
"Note: In an empty place, her abilities should be enhanced even further."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To ensure that, I asked every single Trainer in Kokura.
...At this hour, nobody will be using the track."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So, what're we starting with?
choice_data_list: First, let's work on shifting your center of gravity during acceleration!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Center of gravity...
You tellin' me to lean forward even more? Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while acting menacingly,
Espoir City listened closely without missing a word.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And during our time in Kokura,
I continued training with her as much as possible—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... Awwwriiiight...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Get in front! Lean into it! And grab 1st place!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's gonna be a great debut race!
Yeah, I'm sure it'll be a great debut race!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
It's way better than just "good"!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna win! Obviously!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna bring my absolute best!!
Here I go—!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ――...Gyahh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over to her. There shouldn't have been
anything on the ground for her to trip on, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I-I'm totallllly fiiine, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! Uh... I just had
too much energy and didn't know my own strength!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm heading out now!
Just watch me from the stands, you idiot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And thus began Espoir City's
debut race!"
